app_info.subtitle: Manage coach sales in SetLuca
app_info.description: SetLuca helps coaches, creators, and experts manage the business work behind sales conversations in direct messages. Connect your SetLuca workspace to review leads and conversations, triage the replies Luca drafts, prepare for calls, track bookings, and inspect campaign and broadcast results. This plugin works only with the connected SetLuca account and the permissions granted to it. Tools that send a message, launch a broadcast, book, move, or cancel a call, or turn on auto-send refuse to run until you confirm.

test_cases.description: In the reviewer workspace, run the morning report. Its sample drafts are older than the report's 24-hour window, so an empty report is the correct result.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run SetLuca's morning report for this workspace. Summarize only the returned report; do not check other SetLuca data or take action.
test_cases.expected_output: Call luca_morning_report. Report only the counts and items it returns, including zero drafts queued in the last 24 hours when the report is empty. Do not add older pending drafts from other tools, invent activity, or imply an action was taken.

test_cases.description: In a reviewer workspace with at least one pending draft, triage the review queue.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my review queue and explain what is waiting.
test_cases.expected_output: Call luca_triage_inbox. Identify pending items and explain their status using the returned queue data. If lead names or draft text are blanked by the reviewer connection, say they are unavailable, not empty. Do not approve or send a reply.

test_cases.description: In a reviewer workspace with sample leads, search for a lead by a known name or handle.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the sample lead named Sana in SetLuca.
test_cases.expected_output: Call luca_find_leads with a query for Sana. Return only matching leads from the tool result. If the name is blanked by the reviewer connection, say it cannot be independently confirmed; do not infer that the lead has no name.

test_cases.description: In a reviewer workspace with a completed call awaiting an outcome, inspect the post-call queue.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which calls still need an outcome in SetLuca?
test_cases.expected_output: Call luca_post_call_queue. List only calls or bookings the tool reports as needing feedback or an outcome. Treat blank sensitive lead details as unavailable. Do not record an outcome.

test_cases.description: In the reviewer workspace, which holds a sample draft campaign and a draft broadcast, inspect campaign performance.
test_cases.user_prompt: How are my SetLuca campaigns and broadcasts performing?
test_cases.expected_output: Call luca_analytics_rollup. Summarize the per-campaign analytics and the broadcasts the tool returns, keeping names and figures consistent with the response. The sample campaign and broadcast are drafts that have not sent, so zero counts are correct; do not invent results.
